title: Soil Diatomite Bathroom Mat Fast-Dry
description_en: Made from diatomaceous earth — a natural mineral from Japan — this bath mat absorbs water instantly and dries in under a minute. No mold, no bacteria, no washing required. A Japanese bathroom revolution.
description_ja: 珪藻土(ケイソウド)製の速乾バスマット。足裏の水を瞬時に吸収し、1分以内に乾燥。カビ・菌が繁殖しにくく洗濯不要。日本発のバスルーム革命。
